title: Content card
overview: A grouped teaser or action surface: one inner link; hit-area wraps the card.
apply_when: A repeating unit of title, media, and one destination or action.
not_when: A Situation Card (job), or wrapping the whole card in `<a>` so AT reads everything as one link.

vs.why: the inner action may be a button; the unit is the card
one inner link, not the whole wrapper

role.overview: A grouped teaser or action surface: one inner link; hit-area wraps the card.
role.apply_when: A repeating unit of title, media, and one destination or action.
role.not_when: A Situation Card (job), or wrapping the whole card in <a> so AT reads everything as one link.

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: One destination or action inside; the card hit-area follows that control.
composition.not_when: Nested competing links in one card.

state.not_when: A dead tile with no control.

state.overview: Pointer is over the card — extra cue.
Keyboard is on the inner link or button. Must stay visible.

accessibility.overview: AT gets one coherent name from the inner control, not the whole card as one link wrapping heading+image+meta.
The hit area is the card, wired to the one inner control.
accessibility.not_when: A tiny text link in the corner only.

accessibility.overview: The focused inner control stays visible.

keyboard.overview: One stop per card (the inner link or button).
keyboard.not_when: Every nested bit of meta is a stop.
